posts.author: Gagan_suryaputra
posts.text: Inflation Is Coming From All Sides — The real impact may show up with a lag. Companies can use cheaper inventory to protect margins for a while, but eventually they’ll have to either raise prices or absorb the extra costs. One hurts demand, the other hurts profitability. The next couple of earnings seasons should show who has enough pricing power to handle this without taking a hit.
